easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, Yedora triggers, returning Fanatical Firebrand from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Fanatical Firebrand enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Fanatical Firebrand face-up.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability from step 1.
Repeat.
